cv_protocol: 10 participant LOSO folds, repeated with three fixed ensemble seed pairs; all14sessions28cells retained
metric: unweighted mean of balanced accuracy across subject x session x interface cells

augmentation.description: Baseline plus covariance masking and cross-subject mixup

adversarial.description: Baseline plus a training-only subject-adversarial head

masked_ssl.description: Fit-only masked log-power reconstruction before baseline fine-tuning
masked_ssl.reconstruction_target: log diagonal covariance, fit-only coordinate standardization
masked_ssl.supervised_restart: same-seed fresh model; replace only pretrained spatial_weight

classical_definition.baseline: exact v3 temporal Euclidean log-covariance ridge
classical_definition.tangent_origin: affine-invariant geometric mean of training-aligned covariances
classical_definition.tangent_mean_weights: equal session; uniform within session; no labels
classical_definition.checkpoints: fixed deterministic fit; no held-out parameter or checkpoint selection
classical_definition.feature_scaling: training-only weighted global scale, exactly as v3

adoption_rule: mean paired CV gain > participant-cluster bootstrap SE of that gain
winner_rule: largest mean paired gain minus paired SE among passing candidates; lexicographic tie break
bootstrap_unit: participant, retaining all sessions/interfaces; average paired replicate differences before subject resampling
uncertainty_note: approximate participant-cluster uncertainty; CV fitting sets overlap; 3 seeds are not 30 independent subjects
final_seed_policy: fixed before CV; do not choose best seed or introduce untested replicate averaging
final_fit_condition: at least one predeclared candidate passes the adoption rule

legacy_diagnostic.interpretation: selection-contaminated legacy-split diagnostic; not an independent test estimate or score of the final all10 model

null_result: report and reproducibility evidence only; no new submission ZIP or all-subject final fit
excluded_from_fitting_in_each_fold: heldout participant EEG including unlabeled SSL data
